translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: 2 KOLINITA
book.title: Folo yana leta anavelu KOLINITA tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Folo velekawowo ana nuwanuwa gilukahihiyena.
KaduꞋe tobohiyakweyao, nuwanuwaku omi wanahalamanena gavaiyaꞋamine Yaubada badi tovetumagana adi yoꞋo tulina tulina Masedoniya ana fafali againe ginuwadogedi-yo nuwadogai-nadi guwana hiseyemauneni.

Yadi seyemauna hidede amine. Vita moyaꞋaina agaidiya hiyemu be higaluvaluvadi lakahi-moꞋena tu vitai-dina agaidiya hivemwamwala-moꞋa, kadu badi koyokoyoꞋavadiyao-moꞋa nonogana yadi velekawowo againe yadi nuwadoga lakahina hiseyemaunena.

Iya tauku akufaiweya ganaꞋawatalatalainedi gavaimi adifaiweya medemi hisena, kadu gavadi vaita taudiyao faꞋidiya tu au aiꞋadi hisena be hikaliꞋuho. Tovetumagana adi yoꞋo mali fafali agaidiya yadi velekawowo hiseusena Yaubada yana kaliva Yudiya ana fafali againe himimiyami-ma adi veluga faꞋina. Tu Masedoniya tovetumagana taudiyao yadi nuwenuweya hihawanuwenuwema, higa vaita anahawahegedi be badi buye yadi mani againe Yaubada yana kaliva hinavelugadi.

Ime anuwenuwedi vaita yadi mani hinasena. Tu hiveyaulowogima faꞋina keke yadi manigaga hidahawahegeni, au nagona taudiyao hihawahegedi Kaiwabu againe kadu ime Yaubada yana tofaisewa agaimeya Yaubada nuwanuwana amine.

MiMasedoniya hidedemi hihuluva faꞋina Taitasi agahevagadonena agayo, “Boi velekawowo faꞋina Kolinita tovetumagana agaidiya umidigahe-yo hivebutu hiseusena. Ma unana unavelugadi be yadi nuwadoga ana seyemauna hinaluyabuna.” Au hidedemi omi faꞋimiya Taitasi agahena.

Omi gaitoma hagihagidi moyaꞋaidi agaidiya wawahivemavemauga, vetumagana againe, laumamala nuwaꞋabiꞋabina againe, halamana againe, dibumuhiga tulina tulina agaidiya kadu ama nuwakabubu againe. Kadu nuwanuwama meda velekawowo ana nuwadoga againe wanawahivemavemauga.

Tu iya keke vaita velekawowo faꞋina gadavehimeyemi, keke. Au mali tovetumagana yadi asehawahega gayakahina be medema againe ganagaluvaluvami be ganahalamanena yami nuwanuwa hawahawahegana kaꞋi velemoꞋena o kaꞋi keke.

Yada Kaiwabu Yesu Keliso yana nuwadoga wahalamanena. Bana kikaiwabuna nonogana omi faꞋimiya givekoyokoyo, higa vaita yana vekoyokoyo againe omi Yaubada againe wanavekikaiwabu. (Meda omi koyokoyo faꞋidiya wanahawahegemi.)
Kivetuvetvnu velekawowo ana sewadi faꞋina.

Yami velekawowo faꞋina yaku kivetuvetunu hidede amine. Gilubodami be gavadi malamala kahegena againe wavebutuna, medema adamoya wanaluyabuna. Omi ami yoꞋo yami velekawowo wamidisena. Tu keke velekawowo-moꞋenaga ana sewadi againe wai wadanagoni. Au velekawowo faꞋina yami nuwanuwa wamadusena.
Au yami mani ana tufo wanalele be yami velekawowo wanaluyabuna. Yami waꞋasehawahega wavebutuna amine, meda yami waꞋasehawahega wanaluyabuna. Gavaimi amifaiweya medemi wanaluyabuna.

FaꞋina kaꞋi yami waꞋasehawahega yami velekawowo wanaseusena, au gavaimi amifaiweya medemi gilubodana Yaubada matane. Yaubada keke gidanuwanuwa vaita yada mani kabiꞋona tu lakahina amine kanaseni. Au gavaimi agaideya gidadauda, medemi kanasena be ginalubodana Bana matane.

Keke vaita gadagahe yami mani lakahina wanasena be koyokoyo yami veluga hinanuhagani-yo hinavelokoloko tu omi wanavefanifani. Adamoya yami lokoloko maꞋi lakahina faꞋina, nuwanuwaku badi hikaliꞋuho-ma faꞋidiya maꞋita wanasena be higa aimo gava tova omi wanakaliꞋuho, badi kadu omi faꞋimiya hinasena. Au hidede amine moyaꞋaimi yami miyami leleleya.
Meda gahe saꞋeyana ada ita leleleya faꞋina Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gidadauda gigayo,

content.text: Hai kaliva aꞋa lakahina giyaudi, au anafata ana tufo keke.
Hai kaliva aꞋa kabiꞋona giyaudi, au anafata keke gidakaliꞋuho.

content: Au hidedemi aꞋa ana egana mana ana yaudi againe moyaꞋaidi yadi ahiyauwa leleleya.
Folo Taitasi Kolinita againe ginaꞋiveninisena be
yadi velekawowo ginavaina.
Tu Yaubada againe gavesiule faꞋina iya nuwanuwaku lakahina ganavelugami amine, Yaubada Taitasi ginuwanuwavelena be ami veluga faꞋina tauna gihawahegena.
Iya gaveꞋoꞋolena be ginaꞋela ginaꞋitami ma gimaduveꞋehe. Tu nuwanuwana lakahina ginavelugami faꞋina, kadu tauna yana nuwenuweya givevai be agaimiya ginaꞋela.
Kadu kaliva saꞋeyana buye aꞋiveninisedi, tobohiyadai-nadi yana hawahega VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna ana laumamala againe faꞋina tovetumagana adi yoꞋo tulina tulina hihawaveyamumuyena.

KaduꞋe keke yadi hawaveyamumugaga hidaveleni. Au ekelesiya moyaꞋaidi bana kalivai-nadi hivegidena be ama vehimeya againe ginavebwaꞋuliyema. Higa ime ahawahegema be ekelesiya tulina tulina yadi velekawowo avaivaina-ma Yudiya tovetumagana agaidiya ananauwena, be medema againe Kaiwabu Tauna ana egana anakilakahina kadu taumeyao yama asehawahega koyokoyo adi veluga faꞋina anaseyemaunena.
Au hidedemi avevai be velekawowo lakahina ana itaveꞋavina againe keke tamo hakwadi anafaiweya ginaꞋitaveloima.
Anuwanuwa-hagihagi be higa mani ana itaveꞋavina againe yama huluva ginalubodana Kaiwabu matane, tu keke Kaiwabugaga au kaliva moyaꞋaidi matadiya.

KaduꞋe tobohiyada saꞋeyana badi buye aꞋiveninisedi, banaꞋe tova a gavaiyehi agagaluvaluvana be medema againe yana asehawahega tova moyaꞋaina kaliva adi veluga faꞋina ahalamanena. Ada adamoya yami bonaꞋabi givetumagane-moꞋena faꞋina, kadu nuwanuwana lakahi-moꞋena ginavelugami.

Tu bana Taitasi ma aku aluna, bana iya buye afififaisewa ami veluga faꞋina. Tu tobohiyadeyao adiꞋiselu ma badi ekelesiya tulina tulina adi loseyana, ada mali kaliva yadi faisewa hiꞋita-yo Keliso ana egana hikilakahina.

Medema faꞋina wanavegaꞋauledi be hidedemi yami nuwanuwa hawahawahegana badi agaidiya wanaseyemaunena, kadu dewai-nadi faꞋina gagakahikahiyemi medema wanavehawaledi, be medema againe tovetumagana adi yoꞋo moyaꞋaidi omi velemodi ma hinahalamanena.
